description: Read mappings together with active traits and objects in one snapshot. Use it when needing a combined registry view and canonical ETag; use catalog_list instead to choose components, structured_data_fetch for an individual dataset, or object_registry to inspect/register a definition. Returns mappings, traits, objects, generatedAt, ETag and registry loader issues. Defaults to a summary; detail full adds schemas. includeInternal exposes hidden objects; otherwise hiddenInternal counts omitted entries. Team definitions and shadowing are reported from live sources. This read-only call writes no snapshot file. Historical mapping fields remain stored data and do not imply current capabilities. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#registry_snapshot; full schema: oods://schemas/registry_snapshot.input.json.

detail.description: summary (default), or full definitions, best with names.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them.

names.description: Exact trait and object names; misses go in notFound.

name: registry_snapshot
title: Snapshot Registry
